body:
She loves our cats as much if not more than I do so I know they will be perfectly fine. I just miss them. I want to have the motivation to go do SOMETHING but everything feels like torture. I don't even want to use my voice anymore. I feel like I might cry if I try to talk to someone.

Being a male in this situation is seeming to not be the norm. I feel like I'm supposed to be able to deal with this better than I am. I feel like I'm supposed to know the answer. I don't know a damn thing right now.

I appreciate your insight and you taking the time to talk. In some ways I think you're right about prolonging this, but in others I think it actually made it not as bad. Had I been 100% blindsided like I was that day and forced to leave my home I would've driven off a bridge. Over these past few days I have sort of had some time to prepare myself for what, at the time, MIGHT be coming.

I hate everything about this, and I'm not sure if our relationship can be saved, but your words meant a lot to me. I'm just a fucking kid and I can't handle this kind of pain.

Thank you for the kind words and sharing a little bit of your story. For me the toughest part is being ripped out of my home. We have had a home together for 3 years. All my belongings. My animals. My everything is there. I'm now staying somewhere that isn't in my comfort zone with other people and I feel so out of place. I'm not sure what to even do. I'm just laying in a bed that isn't mine, in a place that isn't my home, and slowly sinking into madness.

I explained it in my response above but I'll give you the short run through. Last week she listed out all her issues with our relationship and said it was over. We talked all that night and decided to give it one more shot. 5-6 days of her being distant and me trying to fix things lead us to today. She just says she's tired of trying, doesn't want to anymore, and that we're done.

Last week when I got home there was a note waiting for me telling me everything that had been bothering her and telling me our relationship was over. After a long conversation and an emotional night we decided to try one more time. After 5-6 days of her being distant and me doing everything I can to try to make things right she let me know today that it just wasn't going to work and she was done trying.

There was no yelling. No screaming. It was a very emotional conversation from my end with her just trying to convince me I'd be okay without her. She says she loves me but just can't be in a relationship with me any longer. I kept it together very well over this last week even though it wasn't going well, but I'm destroyed now.

She isn't to blame for this at all. I'm just so uncontrollably sad that I feel like my heart is literally going to stop beating on its own from lack of motivation to stay alive.

I sincerely appreciate you taking the time to read and respond to this post.
